name: CVaR-PPO
description: PPO (Stable-Baselines3) with the CPPO tail-risk penalty of FinRL-DeepSeek: steps whose estimated episode return falls below the (1 - 0.8) quantile of the rollout lose advantage in proportion to the shortfall, weight 1. Same environment, features and checkpoint selection as the PPO entrant. trials = 5: a 50000-step trial of alpha 0.9, weight 1 plus a declared grid of 4 at 200000 steps (alpha 0.9, 0.8, 0.95 with weight 1; alpha 0.9 with weight 5), compared by mean validation Sharpe over the three ranked tasks and 2 seeds.
